items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: That's the boy we picked up playing Marvel to play in our band. Nonel Thomas, that's the boy that we made as drum hunter.

ctx.x: Lionel Thomas. That's the one I told you that he slipped off and went to Baton Rouge. And that's the boy we, you remember I told you I picked up a boy, they picked up a boy in a band just like they did with me, a young boy. I had to bring him home after the dance. You were younger than I was. Yeah, he was a drummer. Lionel Thomas.
I have a hard time understanding Kid Thomas' daddy's pronunciation, you know.
